You made two mistakes: first, you used a malformed jq expression '.}}' which caused a syntax error, and second, you targeted the wrong endpoint. The task asks for the 'combined status' of the latest commit, which requires the /commits/main/status endpoint (not /statuses/refs/heads/main, which returns individual statuses). You should have run: curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/octocat/Hello-World/commits/main/status | jq . — and you never recovered from the error, ending in failure.

The task was to get the COMBINED status of the latest commit, which requires the endpoint /repos/octocat/Hello-World/commits/main/status (combined status), not /statuses/main (which returned 404) or /commits/main (which you queried with a non-existent .latest_sha field, returning null). You should have first fetched the commit SHA via /commits/main and parsed .sha, then queried /commits/{sha}/status, or directly called /commits/main/status. The agent never obtained the combined status and ended with a null result.
